text:
Mina: quick sketch + loom of a simplified prereq failure flow focusing on mobile drawer behavior and ARIA semantics. link in thread.
Theo: Love the simplification. On mobile, the drawer header feels crowded when hostnames are long. Can we show a short title and full hostname in the subheading?
Riley: Accessibility: header should read 'Network logs for <host>' with aria-level=2. Also ensure the drawer sets aria-hidden on background content while open.
Sam: UX note: when the drawer opens from a collapsed host, focus should move to the drawer close button first, then to primary actions. Closing returns focus to the host row.
Mina: Agreed. Proposed copy: header 'Network logs' and subhead 'foo.example.com' to reduce truncation. Add a tooltip on the hostname for full copy.
Theo: For the failure summary line, prefer 'Network check failed  SSH timed out' instead of 'Probe errored'. Short and actionable.
Riley: Use role="status" for that summary and aria-live="polite". But avoid announcing both the status and the drawer content twice. We should announce only the summary on open.
Sam: On small screens, replace retry+logs buttons with a sticky footer that includes 'Retry network probe' and 'Open logs'. Keeps actions reachable.
Mina: Good call. Also adding a 6s toast when a retry is initiated with an 'Undo' action. If logs are open, keep the toast persistent until logs close.
Theo: Color contrast: the amber callout needs darker text. I recommend switching to dark #3b2a00 text on light amber background. Run contrast check to reach 4.5:1 for 12px small text.
Riley: Notes for developers: ensure drawer has role=dialog with aria-modal=true, focus trap only within drawer, but close with Esc returns focus properly. Also give action buttons descriptive aria-labels (e.g., 'Retry network probe for foo.example.com').
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build uploaded: prereq-mobile-drawer-aria at 2367890110
Mina: I'll update Figma and push the PR with screenshots of the sticky footer, header/subhead pattern, and aria attributes. @Riley can you run a quick a11y sweep post-merge?
Riley: Yep. Checklist: header semantics, aria-modal, role=status announcement, no duplicate speaks, contrast >=4.5, focus return.
Sam: :thumbsup: aiming to land this in the next patch, ping if anyone sees copy issues.
